title: षष्ठोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Vidura comes to the Pandavas in the Kamyaka forest and tells Yudhishthira what happened. He counsels him to bear his trials patiently and wait for the right time, sharing what he has with his allies, and Yudhishthira promises to follow his advice.
summary.kn: ವಿದುರನು ಕಾಮ್ಯಕವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಂಡವರಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬಂದು ನಡೆದುದನ್ನು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ತಾಳ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಕಷ್ಟ ಸಹಿಸಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾಯು, ಮಿತ್ರರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹಂಚಿಕೋ ಎಂದು ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಪಾಲಿಸುವೆನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: विदुर काम्यक वन में पाण्डवों के पास आकर युधिष्ठिर को सारी घटना बताते हैं। वे सलाह देते हैं कि धैर्य से कष्ट सहें, उचित समय की प्रतीक्षा करें और अपने सहयोगियों के साथ बाँटें, और युधिष्ठिर उनकी सलाह मानने का वचन देते हैं।
summary.te: విదురుడు కామ్యకవనంలో పాండవుల వద్దకు వచ్చి జరిగినది యుధిష్ఠిరునికి చెబుతాడు. సహనంతో కష్టాలు భరించి సరైన సమయం కోసం వేచి ఉండు, మిత్రులతో పంచుకో అని సలహా ఇస్తాడు; యుధిష్ఠిరుడు పాటిస్తానంటాడు.
summary.ta: விதுரர் காம்யக வனத்தில் பாண்டவர்களிடம் வந்து நடந்ததை யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் சொல்கிறார். பொறுமையுடன் துன்பங்களைத் தாங்கிச் சரியான நேரத்துக்குக் காத்திருக்குமாறும், நண்பர்களுடன் பகிர்ந்துகொள்ளுமாறும் அறிவுரை சொல்ல, யுதிஷ்டிரர் பின்பற்றுவதாக வாக்களிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: വിദുരൻ കാമ്യകവനത്തിൽ പാണ്ഡവരെ സന്ദർശിച്ച് സംഭവിച്ചതെല്ലാം യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെ അറിയിക്കുന്നു. ദുരിതങ്ങൾ ക്ഷമയോടെ സഹിച്ച് ഉചിതമായ സമയം കാത്തിരിക്കാനും സഖ്യകക്ഷികളുമായി തനിക്കുള്ളത് പങ്കിടാനും അദ്ദേഹം ഉപദേശിക്കുന്നു; യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ഉപദേശം പാലിക്കാമെന്ന് വാക്കു നൽകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.6; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
पाण्डवास्तु वने वासमुद्दिश्य भरतर्षभाः ।
प्रययुर्जाह्नवीकूलात्कुरुक्षेत्रं सहानुगाः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, bulls of the Bharata line, resolved on living in the forest, left the bank of the Ganga with their followers and went to Kurukshetra.

verses.text:
सरस्वतीदृषद्वत्यौ यमुनां च निषेव्य ते ।
ययुर्वनेनैव वनं सततं पश्चिमां दिशम् ॥

meaning.en: Resorting to the Sarasvati, Drishadvati and Yamuna, they went on from forest to forest, always westward.

verses.text:
ततः सरस्वतीकूले समेषु मरुधन्वसु ।
काम्यकं नाम ददृशुर्वनं मुनिजनप्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, on the bank of the Sarasvati, on the level desert land, they saw the Kamyaka forest, dear to sages.

verses.text:
तत्र ते न्यवसन्वीरा वने बहुमृगद्विजे ।
अन्वास्यमाना मुनिभिः सान्त्व्यमानाश्च भारत ॥

meaning.en: There those heroes dwelt in the forest full of beasts and birds, attended by sages and comforted by them, descendant of Bharata.

verses.text:
विदुरस्त्वपि पाण्डूनां तदा दर्शनलालसः ।
जगामैकरथेनैव काम्यकं वनमृद्धिमत् ॥

meaning.en: Vidura too, then longing to see the sons of Pandu, went in a single chariot to the prosperous Kamyaka forest.

verses.text:
ततो यात्वा विदुरः काननं त-
च्छीघ्रैरश्वैर्वाहिना स्यन्दनेन ।
ददर्शासीनं धर्मराजं विविक्ते
सार्धं द्रौपद्या भ्रातृभिर्ब्राह्मणैश्च ॥

meaning.en: Going to that wood in a chariot drawn by swift horses, Vidura saw Dharmaraja seated in a secluded spot with Draupadi, his brothers and the Brahmins.

verses.text:
ततोऽपश्यद्विदुरं तूर्णमारा-
दभ्यायान्तं सत्यसंधः स राजा ।
अथाब्रवीद्भ्रातरं भीमसेनं
किं नु क्षत्ता वक्ष्यति नः समेत्य ॥

meaning.en: The truthful king saw Vidura coming quickly from afar, and said to his brother Bhimasena, "What will Vidura tell us on meeting us?"

verses.text:
कच्चिन्नायं वचनात्सौबलस्य
समाह्वाता देवनायोपयाति ।
कच्चित्क्षुद्रः शकुनिर्नायुधानि
जेष्यत्यस्मान्पुनरेवाक्षवत्याम् ॥

meaning.en: Has he not been sent here by Shakuni's word to summon us to the dice? Will the petty Shakuni not win our weapons from us again in a game?

verses.text:
समाहूतः केनचिदाद्रवेति
नाहं शक्तो भीमसेनापयातुम् ।
गाण्डीवे वा संशयिते कथंचि-
द्राज्यप्राप्तिः संशयिता भवेन्नः ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena, if someone summons me with "Come!" I cannot refuse; and if somehow the Gandiva is put at risk, our winning of the kingdom would be at risk.

verses.text:
तत उत्थाय विदुरं पाण्डवेयाः
प्रत्यगृह्णन्नृपते सर्व एव ।
तैः सत्कृतः स च तानाजमीढो
यथोचितं पाण्डुपुत्रान्समेयात् ॥

meaning.en: Then all the Pandavas rose and welcomed Vidura, king. Honored by them, that descendant of Ajamidha met the sons of Pandu as was fitting.

verses.text:
समाश्वस्तं विदुरं ते नरर्षभा-
स्ततोऽपृच्छन्नागमनाय हेतुम् ।
स चापि तेभ्यो विस्तरतः शशंस
यथावृत्तो धृतराष्ट्रोऽऽम्बिकेयः ॥

meaning.en: When Vidura was at ease, those bulls among men asked the reason for his coming, and he told them in detail how Dhritarashtra, Ambika's son, had acted.

verses.text: विदुर उवाच

meaning.en: Vidura said:

verses.text:
अवोचन्मां धृतराष्ट्रोऽनुगुप्त-
मजातशत्रो परिगृह्याभिपूज्य ।
एवं गते समतामभ्युपेत्य
पथ्यं तेषां मम चैव ब्रवीहि ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra, taking me aside, embracing and honoring me, said: "Ajatashatru, things being as they are, be impartial and tell me what is good for them and for me."

verses.text:
मयाप्युक्तं यत्क्षमं कौरवाणां
हितं पथ्यं धृतराष्ट्रस्य चैव ।
तद्वै पथ्यं तन्मनो नाभ्युपैति
ततश्चाहं क्षममन्यन्न मन्ये ॥

meaning.en: I spoke what was fitting for the Kauravas and good for Dhritarashtra, but that good counsel did not enter his mind, so I see no other fitting course.

verses.text:
परं श्रेयः पाण्डवेया मयोक्तं
न मे तच्च श्रुतवानाम्बिकेयः ।
यथातुरस्येव हि पथ्यमन्नं
न रोचते स्मास्य तदुच्यमानम् ॥

meaning.en: Sons of Pandu, I told him the highest good, but Ambika's son did not hear it. As wholesome food is unwelcome to a sick man, so it did not please him when told.

verses.text:
न श्रेयसे नीयतेऽजातशत्रो
स्त्री श्रोत्रियस्येव गृहे प्रदुष्टा ।
ब्रुवन्न रुच्यै भरतर्षभस्य
पतिः कुमार्या इव षष्टिवर्षः ॥

meaning.en: He is not led to what is good, Ajatashatru, as a corrupt wife in the house of a Vedic scholar is not, and I was unwelcome to that bull of the Bharatas, like a sixty-year-old husband to a young girl.

verses.text:
ध्रुवं विनाशो नृप कौरवाणां
न वै श्रेयो धृतराष्ट्रः परैति ।
यथा पर्णे पुष्करस्येव सिक्तं
जलं न तिष्ठेत्पथ्यमुक्तं तथास्मिन् ॥

meaning.en: Surely the Kauravas will be destroyed, king; Dhritarashtra will not come to his good. As water sprinkled on a lotus leaf does not stay, so good advice does not stay with him.

verses.text:
ततः क्रुद्धो धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीन्मां
यत्र श्रद्धा भारत तत्र याहि ।
नाहं भूयः कामये त्वां सहायं
महीमिमां पालयितुं पुरं वा ॥

meaning.en: Then angry, Dhritarashtra said to me, "Go where you have faith, descendant of Bharata. I no longer want you as my helper to protect this earth or the city."

verses.text:
सोऽहं त्यक्तो धृतराष्ट्रेण राजं-
स्त्वां शासितुमुपयातस्त्वरावान् ।
तद्वै सर्वं यन्मयोक्तं सभायां
तद्धार्यतां यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि भूयः ॥

meaning.en: So, abandoned by Dhritarashtra, king, I have come quickly to advise you. Keep in mind all that I said in the assembly, and hold to what I now say again.

verses.text:
क्लेशैस्तीव्रैर्युज्यमानः सपत्नैः
क्षमां कुर्वन्कालमुपासते यः ।
सं वर्धयन्स्तोकमिवाग्निमात्मवा-
न्स वै भुङ्क्ते पृथिवीमेक एव ॥

meaning.en: One who, pressed by fierce afflictions from rivals, bides his time with patience, feeding his strength like a small fire, and is self-controlled, will alone enjoy the earth.

verses.text:
यस्याविभक्तं वसु राजन्सहायै-
स्तस्य दुःखेऽप्यंशभाजः सहायाः ।
सहायानामेष संग्रहणेऽभ्युपायः
सहायाप्तौ पृथिवीप्राप्तिमाहुः ॥

meaning.en: A king whose wealth is shared with his helpers will have helpers who share his sorrow too. This is the means of winning helpers; they say that having helpers brings the earth.

verses.text:
सत्यं श्रेष्ठं पाण्डव निष्प्रलापं
तुल्यं चान्नं सह भोज्यं सहायैः ।
आत्मा चैषामग्रतो नातिवर्ते-
देवंवृत्तिर्वर्धते भूमिपालः ॥

meaning.en: Truth, Pandava, is best and free of idle talk; eat the same food, sharing a meal with helpers, and let one's own self not go ahead of them. Thus a king prospers by such conduct.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
एवं करिष्यामि यथा ब्रवीषि
परां बुद्धिमुपगम्याप्रमत्तः ।
यच्चाप्यन्यद्देशकालोपपन्नं
तद्वै वाच्यं तत्करिष्यामि कृत्स्नम् ॥

meaning.en: I will do just as you say, attaining the highest resolve and without carelessness. And whatever else, suited to place and time, you may need to say, I will carry out all of it.
